name: Ijoku
source:
The previous hospital director's son is out for revenge on the current director who drove his father to suicide. Posing as an amnesia victim he works as the hospital janitor and works on the nursing staff up to the top.

[from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=7824]Anime News Network[/url]]
translation:
前任医院院长之子向现任院长展开复仇，后者曾逼迫其父自杀。他假扮成失忆患者，在医院里担任清洁工，并逐步向护理人员乃至高层下手。

[摘自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=7824]Anime News Network[/url]]
